messages:
ana (partnerships): Heads-up — Azure marketplace PO came through for QuantumEdge Edge-G12 but ingestion failed due to ledger alias mismatch. PO: 2024-AX-889120.
marketplace-bot: Automated alert: INBOUND_PO_REJECTED - reason: ledger_account_not_found (vendor_alias: QNTM-EDGE)
sam (finance-ops): Paste the PO id and invoice ref so I can see if finance can allocate temporarily.
nana (partnerships) typo edit: ignore
ana (partnerships) edit: PO 2024-AX-889120, invoice INV-7312 in AP. ledger shows "N/A". procurement says vendor alias not linked.
leah (vendor-ops): Do we have a signed amendment? We updated remit/ledger instructions in the MSA amendment, alias changes need that to flow.
raj (legal): Theres a redline pending from QuantumEdge on net terms (net-30 vs net-45). If they haven't executed the amendment we can't apply alias changes permanently.
mike (solutions): Ingestion log: ```json
{"po_id":"2024-AX-889120","vendor_alias":"QNTM-EDGE","ledger_account":null,"error":"ledger_account_not_found"}
```
sam (finance-ops): We can do a one-off manual allocation if partnerships + vendor-ops OK, but need written partner confirmation to avoid billing exposure.
nana (partnerships): I just pinged Claire at QuantumEdge for written approval to use alias QNTM-EDGE temporarily while legal finishes redline.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: PO hold window expires in 36 hours (auto cancel if no mapping).
raj (legal): I can accept a conditional temporary mapping if partner explicitly confirms in writing. I'll mark the redline as low-risk for this temporary flow. ETA ~2 hours.
leah (vendor-ops): Once we have partner email and legal sign-off, I can create a temporary ledger mapping (30-day expiry) and route AP to map INV-7312 to PO 2024-AX-889120.
mike (solutions): Partner contact is claire@quantumedge.com, I just CC'd her on the ask.
nana (partnerships): Partner replied (copied): "Claire, QuantumEdge: Confirmed we approve using alias QNTM-EDGE for PO 2024-AX-889120 while final MSA is under review.")
sam (finance-ops): With that email and legal conditional OK, finance will allocate and prevent revenue recognition hit.
raj (legal): Confirmed - conditional approval granted based on partner email. I'll finalize the MSA redline and circulate the signed amendment once done.
leah (vendor-ops): Temp mapping created and applied: mapping id TMP-2024-QE-01, expires in 30 days, note references partner email and legal approval. AP notified and invoice routed.
sam (finance-ops): Allocation completed, AP ack'd, revenue hold cleared.
nana (partnerships): Closing loop. Will add a short note to the partner onboarding checklist about ledger alias lead times and require amendment status before PO ingestion to reduce cycles.
mike (solutions): I'll add a short postmortem action: add a validation step in marketplace ingestion to flag missing MSA-backed alias changes earlier.
marketplace-bot: Thread marked resolved by ana (partnerships).
